narr: A cluster of slow-moving thunderstorms drifted east across the Upper Ohio Valley. A segment of training storms were focused across Jefferson County, Ohio in the area of Winterville and Steubenville, where over 2 inches fell in an hour and caused flash flooding issues in those areas.
ev: Two to three inches of rainfall over just over an hour caused flash flooding across much of Steubenville. Several houses were reported to be inundated with water as well as several road closures due to high water.
lsr: SEVERAL HOUSES IN STEUBENVILLE REPORTED TO BE FLOODING AS WELL AS SEVERAL ROADS FLOODED WITH HIGH WATER.
